# A host whose three mechanisms disagree. The Content-Usage rule allows
# training, the Content-Signal line disallows AI input and training, and the
# licence permits AI input and training under payment.
License: https://contradictory.example/license.xml

User-agent: *
Allow: /
Content-Usage: train-ai=y, search=y
Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=no, ai-train=no
